slides.big: The 24 hours after your long run
slides.sub: Five things to do before Monday.

slides.title: EAT SOON
slides.head: Get a proper meal in within an hour or so.
slides.body: Carbs and some protein. Coffee alone is not breakfast.

slides.title: TOP UP
slides.head: Drink steadily through the day.
slides.body: If you came home white with salt, add some salt back with your food.

slides.title: KEEP MOVING
slides.head: A walk beats a whole day on the couch.
slides.body: Easy movement helps stiff legs loosen up.

slides.title: SLEEP EARLY
slides.head: Sleep is where the training sinks in.
slides.body: An early Sunday night pays you back all week.

slides.title: GO EASY
slides.head: Make Monday a rest day or a very easy run.
slides.body: Feeling fresh is not a reason to smash it. Wait for your next quality session.

carousel.caption:
The long run is only half the job. The next 24 hours are the other half.
Eat soon, drink, keep moving, sleep early, and go easy on Monday.
Save this for your next long run.
